args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

Gideon: you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug (both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showing a white screen after badge scan). The guard was logging trailer numbers by hand on a clipboard. The channel shows no other guard activity until Mateo posted at 11:03 AM that kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836 there. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes had been working since 11:07. Mateo also noted six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44. All times are as shown in this channel.

I replied in the thread. You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant were showing a white screen after badge scan.

Those times are as they appear in the channel. The channel doesn't state a time zone.
